facts.raw_span: A 72-year-old female
with a BMI of 19.23
presented with intermittent pain in right lumbar and abdomen
with chills and fever for 1 year
The symptoms would relieve with anti-inflammatory therapy
but recurred repeatedly
Patient was previously physically fit
with no history of coronary disease, hypertension, diabetes, or chronic bronchitis
Physical examination showed no obvious positive signs
CT Examination: Shows proximal ureter dilation and hydronephrosis
Revealed herniation into the greater sciatic foramen with proximal ureteral dilatation
proximal ureteral dilatation
